reasons.claim: One eligible species is recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, and none within 250 m. Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant, forest-associated, site-bound) has 4 records, the nearest at 704 m (2022, 25 m uncertainty). Its threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness in tree-covered land.

No eligible species are recorded within 250 m. The only red-listed record there is Dryobates minor (NT, a mobile bird, 2017, 200 m uncertainty). It is supporting evidence only and does not count as eligible.

Other threatened species within 1000 m are mobile birds or are not felling-relevant. They are Circus cyaneus (VU), Apus apus (VU) and Fraxinus excelsior (EN, no felling factors listed). They do not trigger the rubric.
Completed felling covers 3.9% of the polygon (0.191 ha, from 2012 and 2022 fellings), so the site is not already felled. The notification is a 4.3 ha regeneration felling.

Effort is adequate (303 records within 1000 m, 86th percentile). Near the site there are 0 records inside the polygon (4 coarse records excluded) and 8 records on 2 days within 250 m. This near-site recording is thin.

uncertainties: The Goodyera repens records are 704 m or more away. They do not show that the species occurs in or next to the polygon.
Near-site recording is sparse (no records inside the polygon, 8 records on 2 days within 250 m), so the lack of eligible records near the site carries little weight.
The Dryobates minor record at 0 m has 200 m uncertainty, which is large compared with the site radius of 126 m.
not_established: That the polygon holds or lacks any red-listed species.
Stand age or condition, because no tool describes it.
Whether the felling is legal or appropriate.
That species not recorded are absent.
next_action: Have a reviewer check whether the habitat of the Goodyera repens records at 704 m or more continues into the polygon. Decide whether a targeted field check is warranted before felling begins.
